interfaces.constraints: Concrete tracking result for the qualified encoder; retains candidate ordering, retry, ranking, reservation and configured round policy. No historical accuracy claim.

Coordinates and pitch share caller-defined length units; coefficients have squared-length units and signed orientation is dimensionless. Nonzero transverse coordinate radius and finite positive absolute pitch-per-radian required. Qualified domain excludes nonfinite intermediate arithmetic or output. Safe denominator substitutions at undefined geometry are outside qualification.

interfaces.name: hit_matrix
interfaces.constraints: Integer resource matrix (N,M) with nonnegative int64 IDs strictly below the nonempty boolean used-mask length. Zero is an empty-slot sentinel. Counts are integers: min_nhits >= 1, max_nloss >= 0, max_nrows >= 0; max_loss_fraction is finite in [0,1]. Rows are processed in supplied order. Duplicate IDs within a row count as repeated positions, not unique resources. Provider copies inputs; caller owns ordering and any mutation or reservation of skipped rows.

interfaces.name: selected
interfaces.constraints: Returns a copied int64 selection matrix and boolean claimed mask with the input shapes. Rejected rows and already-claimed positions are zeroed. Accepted rows claim their resource IDs; rejected rows claim nothing. The sentinel mask entry is always true. Ordered greedy selection is not a globally optimal allocation. Empty matrices and all-zero rows are accepted by this atom, unlike the stricter source recipe.

interfaces.name: claimed
interfaces.constraints: Returns a copied int64 selection matrix and boolean claimed mask with the input shapes. Rejected rows and already-claimed positions are zeroed. Accepted rows claim their resource IDs; rejected rows claim nothing. The sentinel mask entry is always true. Ordered greedy selection is not a globally optimal allocation. Empty matrices and all-zero rows are accepted by this atom, unlike the stricter source recipe.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (N,3), caller-defined length units. Empty batches allowed. For a unit oriented tangent, caller must supply points on the transverse circles.

interfaces.name: tangents
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 matrix (N,3), dimensionless, not necessarily unit vectors. Regulation may change direction and destroys scale invariance near its thresholds.

interfaces.name: pitch
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 vector (N,), signed axial length per revolution in the same units as points.

interfaces.name: minimum_axial
interfaces.constraints: Positive finite real scalar, dimensionless. Floors axial tangent magnitude; zero uses positive sign. Caller selects this regularization policy.

interfaces.name: maximum_scale
interfaces.constraints: Positive finite real scalar in point length units. Clips the construction scale magnitude after finite division. Caller selects this regularization policy.

interfaces.name: centers
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 transverse centers (N,2), in point length units.

interfaces.name: radius
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite nonnegative float64 radii (N,), in point length units.

interfaces.name: xi
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty aligned finite float64 vectors (N,). Coordinates, helix radius and pitch share caller-defined length units; coefficients have squared-length units and signed orientation is dimensionless. Nonzero transverse coordinate radius and positive helix radius required. Curvature denominator (radius squared plus absolute pitch-per-radian squared) divided by radius must be finite and positive. Qualified domain excludes nonfinite intermediate arithmetic or output.

Flags are independent and may both be true. Equality does not pass the respective strict comparison. No calibrated probability or symbolic decision proof is claimed.

interfaces.constraints: Nonempty aligned finite float64 vector. Coordinates, centers and pitch share a caller-defined length unit. No broadcasting. Qualified domain excludes nonfinite intermediate arithmetic; point pairs and center define the caller-selected transverse rotation sense.

interfaces.name: hel_dz
interfaces.constraints: Aligned float64 direction indicator in caller length units: axial difference, or for equal-height points pitch times transverse rotation sign. Zero is possible, including coincident points. This is not a unit vector or probability. The symbolic expression covers only the axial-difference branch; no symbolic fallback proof is claimed.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 (N,3) positions sharing origin and length unit with reference. Nonzero finite radial normalization required; empty batches allowed.

interfaces.name: reference
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 (N,3), exactly aligned with points. Displacement is points minus reference; no broadcasting.

interfaces.name: polar
interfaces.constraints: Signed length projected onto sign(z) times the increasing-colatitude basis. Zero at z=0; not an angular displacement. Nonfinite arithmetic rejects.

interfaces.name: azimuth
interfaces.constraints: Signed length along increasing azimuth about the z axis. Axis positions reject. Empty inputs return empty vectors.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (Q,D) matching fitted axis order and units. Empty queries allowed; no coordinate conversion.

interfaces.name: state
interfaces.constraints: Opaque RegularGridInterpolator runtime state with linear method, bounds_error=False and fill_value=None. Must remain unmodified; not a portable serialized artifact.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Float64 interpolated values with shape (Q,) plus trailing value dimensions. Linear extrapolation outside the grid; nonfinite results reject. No physical validity or interpolation error bound.

interfaces.name: axes
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty tuple/list of finite float64 vectors, each strictly ascending or descending with at least two entries. Caller defines units; no sorting or singleton removal.

interfaces.name: values
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 values whose leading dimensions match axis lengths; optional trailing component dimensions. Caller storage is copied.

interfaces.name: state
interfaces.constraints: Opaque RegularGridInterpolator runtime state with linear method, bounds_error=False and fill_value=None. Must remain unmodified; not a portable serialized artifact.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite float32 or float64 matrix (N,D). Input precision is preserved and storage copied. Caller controls feature scaling and the Euclidean metric; no domain identifiers or partitioning policy.

interfaces.name: n_clusters
interfaces.constraints: Positive integer K <= N; booleans rejected. Duplicate points can yield fewer distinct clusters.

interfaces.name: random_state
interfaces.constraints: Integer seed in [0, 2**32-1]; booleans rejected. No cross-version reproducibility guarantee.

interfaces.name: n_init
interfaces.constraints: Positive integer restart count. Each run uses k-means++ initialization; best inertia is selected by the installed backend.

interfaces.constraints: Finite nonnegative scalar in the feature distance unit. Inclusive boundary; zero radius allowed. Booleans rejected.

interfaces.name: distances
interfaces.constraints: Object array (Q,) of float64 distance vectors, one per query; empty rows allowed, backend order unsorted. Ties and unsorted ordering are backend/version dependent; no extra stable sorting. Nonfinite returned distances reject.

interfaces.name: indices
interfaces.constraints: Object array (Q,) of integer fitted-row index vectors, aligned with distance rows. Ties and unsorted ordering are backend/version dependent; no extra stable sorting. Nonfinite returned distances reject.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (N,3), caller-defined length units. Empty batches allowed. For a unit oriented tangent, caller must supply points on the transverse circles.

interfaces.name: centers
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 transverse centers (N,2), in point length units.

interfaces.name: radius
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite nonnegative float64 radii (N,), in point length units.

interfaces.name: pitch
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 vector (N,), signed axial length per revolution in the same units as points.

interfaces.name: axial_direction
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 vector (N,). Only its sign is used; product with pitch must be finite and representably nonzero.

interfaces.name: tangent
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 oriented tangent matrix (N,3). Unit length only when supplied points lie on their transverse circles; inconsistent geometry is not normalized.

interfaces.name: measured
interfaces.constraints: Finite nonnegative float64 vector (N,) in caller-defined uncertainty units. Empty vectors allowed.

interfaces.name: driver
interfaces.constraints: Finite signed float64 vector (N,), exactly aligned with measured. Coefficients convert driver units to measured units.

interfaces.name: driver_scale
interfaces.constraints: Explicit finite nonnegative real scalar; booleans rejected. First multiplication is driver times driver_scale.

interfaces.name: component_scale
interfaces.constraints: Explicit finite nonnegative real scalar; booleans rejected. Applied after driver_scale; empirical values belong to the recipe.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Float64 vector sqrt(measured**2 + ((driver*driver_scale)*component_scale)**2). Independent components assumed by caller; nonfinite intermediate or output rejects.

interfaces.name: reference
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (N,D), D>=1. Empty batches and zero vectors allowed. Caller defines units; no normalization.

interfaces.name: first
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 candidate matrix aligned to reference. Chosen only if its absolute inner product is strictly larger than second.

interfaces.name: second
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 candidate matrix aligned to reference. Chosen on ties. Equal candidate lengths and nonzero vectors are needed for an angular closest-axis interpretation.

interfaces.name: selected
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 selected vector matrix (N,D), negated when its reference inner product is negative; zero inner product leaves orientation unchanged. Inputs are not modified.

interfaces.name: inner
interfaces.constraints: Finite nonnegative float64 vector (N,) of selected absolute inner products. No confidence score or normalization; nonfinite arithmetic rejects before selection.

limits: Complete tracking behavior with explicit geometry injection; remaining decomposition and canonical provider qualification precede original publication.
Synthetic analytic maps exercise correction application; learned calibration and historical accuracy remain unqualified.

limitations: Synthetic cell-free/cell-enabled events and complete analytic runtime maps; no learned calibration claim.
Runtime parameters selected for synthetic event size; no competition accuracy claim.
Outputs captured in memory; ground-truth scoring and diagnostic/file output paths excluded.
Explicit empty-candidate and no-seed stops added to candidate and source reference; raw source failures counted separately. Sparse/exhausted layer behavior remains.
Adapter qualifies only the retained configured tracking recipe with the twenty-five exact callables listed here.
Detector topology, candidate lifecycle, retry, ranking, identifier and map dispatch policy remain domain-specific.
Generic providers remain separately selectable; arbitrary replacement callables are not qualified.
Retained cell reconstruction arithmetic remains in the recipe and requires a separate reuse/scope review before original-CDG publication.
Prepared state and result are concrete runtime objects, not portable serialized artifacts.
Automated Tier3 evidence only; no human Tier1 review or usage-qualified Tier2 claim.
Installed dependency file integrity does not establish publisher authentication or clean deployment on other platforms.
Canonical artifact interfaces define graph dependencies; some legacy atom records intentionally have no versioned interfaces and are preserved.
Original-CDG scope and publication gates remain separate.
